Fixed and shipped. entity_media now persists a media_evidence object beside image_url (subject, context, provider, source_class, verified dimensions, content type, verified_at) and media_judge's pinned fallback consumes it. Measured on the real scorer: bare URL 0.133 weak, verified-with-subject 0.817 strong, verified-only-no-subject 0.317 weak — so a verified encyclopedic photo no longer orders a generated replacement for itself, and verification alone still cannot certify subject relevance. The self-certification rule is enforced by shape: verify_shot_urls writes no title at all, evidence whose url does not match the shot's is ignored, non-dicts are ignored, and evidence is dropped whenever its URL is. probe_image replaces url_is_image's throw-away yes/no (url_is_image delegates to it) and reads dimensions from the first 64KB; an unparseable header leaves them 0, which the judge correctly treats as unverified. Host classification is conservative. 14 tests including the end-to-end case; 9 fail/error against the unfixed files.

Fixed and shipped. The expired/corrupt/re-entrant reclaim path is now exclusive via a <claim>.json.reclaim lock, with a re-read of the claim INSIDE the lock as the actual decision — a late worker reads an active claim that is not its own and loses. Neither the lock nor the re-read alone is sufficient, so both are there. A lock orphaned by a dead worker ages out after RECLAIM_LOCK_SECONDS and is stolen, following the same rule as the lease, and the re-read still guards the write. The lock file does not match the *.json glob so nothing reads it as a claim. Five tests including the threaded two-worker race; three fail against the unfixed file on every run.
